items.title: What is Social Science?
items.explanation: Social science is not like physics or chemistry; it does not use fixed procedures to get set results. Instead, because human societies are diverse and complex, social science focuses on understanding human society through five broad themes: Geography (Theme A), History (Theme B), Cultural Heritage (Theme C), Governance (Theme D), and the current state of humanity (Theme E).

items.title: Understanding Human Diversity
items.explanation: Social science helps us understand that human societies are very diverse and complex. This diversity makes it difficult to find simple answers to fundamental questions about how we solve problems, live in peace, and protect our planet.
